unexpressed.text: Only roll for a NET CREDIT. If the roll costs a debit, close the position instead - paying to stay in a losing trade is the most expensive habit in options.
unexpressed.reason: rolling is not implemented in v1 (design 5.4)

unexpressed.text: VALIDATION (must be enforced on every roll): the new short's expiry must be STRICTLY EARLIER than the covering long's expiry. Rolling past the long's expiry silently creates a reverse diagonal and an uncovered short.
unexpressed.reason: rolling is not implemented in v1 (design 5.4)

unexpressed.text: VALIDATION: for calls, new short strike >= long strike + cumulative net debit; for puts, new short strike <= long strike - cumulative net debit.
